job.title: Full Stack Developer Intern @ The Career Ads (UP, IN)
job.description:
We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic **Full Stack Developer Intern** to join our **Aara Group** team. This internship is suitable for freshers, students, and aspiring developers who want to gain practical experience in modern web application development.

As a Full Stack Developer Intern, you will work on real-world projects and learn to develop applications using **Python, Django, React.js, Next.js, and Node.js** under the guidance of experienced developers.

**Key** **Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain web applications using **Python, Django, React.js, Next.js, and Node.js**.
* Build responsive and user-friendly frontend interfaces.
* Develop backend APIs and server-side functionality.
* Work with databases such as **MySQL/PostgreSQL/MongoDB**.
* Integrate frontend applications with REST APIs.
* Write clean, reusable, and maintainable code.
* Debug and resolve application issues.
* Participate in code reviews and technical discussions.
* Use **Git and GitHub** for version control.
* Work on assigned tasks and real-world development projects.
* Learn and follow software development best practices.

**Skills Required**

* Basic knowledge of **Python and JavaScript**.
* Understanding of **HTML, CSS, and JavaScript**.
* Basic knowledge of **React.js**.
* Familiarity with **Django/Django REST Framework** is an advantage.
* Basic understanding of **Node.js and Next.js** is preferred.
* Knowledge of databases and SQL is an advantage.
* Basic understanding of REST APIs.
* Familiarity with Git/GitHub.
* Good problem-solving and logical thinking skills.
* Willingness to learn new technologies.

**Who Can Apply?**

* B.Tech / BCA / MCA / B.Sc. Computer Science or related students/graduates.
* Freshers looking to start a career in Full Stack Development.
* Candidates with academic, personal, or portfolio projects.
* Candidates with basic programming knowledge who are eager to learn.
* Students looking for practical industry exposure.

**What You Will Gain**

* Practical experience in **Full Stack Web Development**.
* Exposure to real-world development projects.
* Hands-on experience with **Python, Django, React.js, Next.js & Node.js**.
* Experience working with APIs and databases.
* Git/GitHub and collaborative development experience.
* Technical mentorship and code-review experience.
* Opportunity to build a strong developer portfolio.
* **Internship certificate**, subject to company requirements.

This is a **learning and practical internship opportunity**. Interns will be assigned responsibilities based on their skills and learning progress. Any further employment opportunity after the internship will depend on **performance, available positions, and company requirements**.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates can apply through **Indeed** with their updated resume. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted regarding the interview and internship process.

**Keywords:** Full Stack Developer Intern, Python Developer Intern, Django Intern, React.js Intern, Next.js Intern, Node.js Intern, Web Development Internship, Software Development Internship, IT Internship, Fresher Internship.

Pay: ₹7,000.00 - ₹10,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

job.title: Senior AI Developer @ Bridgenext (MH, IN)
job.description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

At Bridgenext, we engineer Growth Operating Systems. Most enterprises have spent millions on their revenue stack and still aren't seeing the growth they expected.They have tools that function, but no system that wins. We help growth-hungry companies close that gap by turning fragmented platforms, siloed teams, and disconnected data into one integrated Growth OS. More than a technology company or marketing agency, we're a global digital consultancy with experts in engineering, data, AI, creative and more.

  

Our teams are made up of experts who believe in engineering impact, starting with putting people at the center of everything we do. Every team member directly shapes our work, culture, and values. Nothing matters more to us than a kind, respectful, fulfilling environment that supports everyone. Our flexible, inclusive culture gives you the autonomy, resources, and opportunities to thrive.

**Position Description**
------------------------

The Senior AI Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and deploying production-grade AI solutions using Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, MCP, AI-enabled SDLC practices, and Microsoft Azure.

  

The role partners with architects, technical leads, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable AI applications, develop reusable components, and integrate AI capabilities into enterprise platforms. The engineer ensures solutions meet standards for security, reliability, performance, observability, cost optimization, and Responsible AI, while contributing to engineering best practices, code quality, and continuous improvement.

  

Key Responsibilities:

* Strong hands-on experience with **Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Foundry/Azure AI services**, and frameworks such as **LangChain/LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex**, or comparable technologies.
* Knowledge of **prompt and context engineering, structured outputs, tool/function calling, agent orchestration, memory, and human-in-the-loop workflows**.
* Implement **MCP servers/clients** to securely connect AI agents with enterprise applications, APIs, data, and tools.
* Strong understanding of **Microsoft Azure architecture**, including Azure AI services, AI Search, API Management, App Services/Functions/Containers, Service Bus, Storage, databases, Key Vault, Entra ID, networking, monitoring, and CI/CD.
* Knowledge of secure, scalable, resilient, observable, and cost-effective cloud architectures using appropriate Azure patterns.
* Strong software engineering experience with **Python, C#/.NET, and/or TypeScript/JavaScript**, including APIs, microservices, distributed systems, SQL/NoSQL, event-driven architecture, automated testing, Git, and CI/CD.
* Leverage **AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or equivalent tools** across design, development, testing, debugging, code review, documentation, and modernization.
* Knowledge of AI evaluation practices covering **accuracy, groundedness, relevance, hallucination, retrieval quality, safety, latency, and cost**.
* Implement AI security and guardrails addressing **prompt injection, sensitive-data leakage, insecure tool execution, excessive agency, authentication/authorization, RBAC, and least privilege**.
* Knowledge **Responsible AI, OWASP LLM security guidance, and NIST AI RMF** principles as appropriate.
  

**Must Have Skills:**

* **4 to 6 years** of experience in software engineering and implementation.
* Strong hands-on experience with **Microsoft Azure and enterprise application architecture**.
* Demonstrated experience developing **Generative AI/LLM solutions**, including RAG and agentic AI.
* Experience taking AI solutions from **prototype/PoC through production deployment**.
* Experience with **MCP, agent/tool integration, and enterprise AI integration**.
* Hands-on experience using **AI coding assistants and development agents throughout the SDLC**.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in **Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence**, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  

**Preferred Skills:**

  

* Microsoft Azure Architecture or AI certifications.
* Experience with enterprise RAG, knowledge architectures, and autonomous/semi-autonomous agents.
* Experience implementing MCP-based enterprise integrations.
* Experience with **MLOps/LLMOps and AI evaluation/observability platforms**.
  

**Professional Skills:**

* Solid written, verbal, and presentation communication skills
* Strong team and individual player
* Maintains composure during all types of situations and is collaborative by nature
* High standards of professionalism, consistently producing high quality results
* Self-sufficient, independent requiring very little supervision or intervention
Demonstrate flexibility and openness to bring creative solutions to address issues  

*Bridgenext is an Equal Opportunity Employer*

Our disruptor's mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654.4M FY26 revenue with 17.4% Y-o-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3.2% Q-o-Q and 16.2% Y-o-Y growth. The role requires strong hands-on expertise in Java, Spring Boot, microservices, Kafka-based event-driven architecture, REST APIs, and production-grade application development. The candidate will work closely with engineering teams, architects, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable, high-performance solutions.

* **Location: Pune**
* **Experience: 8 to 10 Years**

* Build and consume RESTful APIs and integrate backend services with upstream and downstream systems
* Work on Kafka producers, consumers, topics, partitions, offsets, consumer groups, and message processing flows
* Participate in application design, code reviews, debugging, performance tuning, and production support activities
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions
* Ensure application scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability across environments

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

* Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, design patterns, data structures, and coding best practices

* Experience with build tools and frameworks such as Maven, Gradle, JUnit, Mockito, Git, and CI/CD pipelines

* Ability to troubleshoot production issues, analyze logs, tune performance, and resolve defects effectively
* Good communication skills with the ability to work independently and collaborate with distributed teams

**Benefits:**

* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:**

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
